entries.name: Verdant Mistwood
entries.description: An old, mist-soaked woodland where every cultivator's road begins. Spirit herbs crowd the glades and the canopy, and the beasts are the quick, wary kind — moths, cranes, deer and young serpents — with older predators denning deeper in, under a forest sovereign who has worn a person's shape for longer than any village has stood.

zones.name: Spirit Herb Valley
zones.description: A mist-veiled valley thick with low-grade spirit plants.

zones.name: Whispering Woods
zones.description: An old forest where beasts prowl between the ancient trunks.

zones.name: Dewleaf Glade
zones.description: A sunlit clearing where dew-laden herbs bloom in soft moss.

zones.name: Mistroot Thicket
zones.description: Tangled roots hide first-grade spirit reeds and clover.

zones.name: Bramblefang Hollow
zones.description: A thorny hollow denned by quick, vicious wood-beasts.

zones.name: Old Pilgrim Road
zones.description: A worn forest road where wanderers cached pills and scrolls.

zones.name: Verdant Canopy
zones.description: The high canopy where rare blossoms drink the morning starlight.

zones.name: Greenmaw Den
zones.description: A reeking burrow ruled by a pack of elder forest predators.

zones.name: Sunlit Clearing
zones.description: A bright meadow at the wood's edge, rich and lightly guarded.

zones.name: Verdant Domain
zones.description: The oldest grove of the Mistwood, where the great trees lean inward as if listening to a single voice.

entries.name: Stonevein Range
entries.description: Broken mountains split by quarries, collapsed mines and caverns that run deeper than anyone has mapped. Ore and spirit-stone are the reason to come; the stone-hided striders, cave serpents and coiled wyrms that guard them are the reason not to stay, and something made of the mountain itself walks its heart.

zones.name: Ironvein Quarry
zones.description: An open quarry where iron and spirit-stone are still chipped free.

zones.name: Gravel Pass
zones.description: A rockslide-prone pass where caravans lose their cargo.

zones.name: Abandoned Spirit Mine
zones.description: Collapsed tunnels still rich with ore — and the things that den there.

zones.name: Emberpeak Ridge
zones.description: A volcanic ridge where fire-natured beasts make their lairs.

zones.name: Cragback Tunnels
zones.description: Winding earthworks where earth essence pools in the dark.

zones.name: Stonebarrow Mine
zones.description: A deep working that strikes veins of mystic ore.

zones.name: Granitespine Cliffs
zones.description: Sheer cliffs where stone-hided striders guard their roosts.

zones.name: Deepdelve Shaft
zones.description: The deepest shaft, where starsteel and bronzecap mushrooms lie under guard.

zones.name: Echoing Caverns
zones.description: Vast lightless caverns where elder wyrms coil around ore hoards.

zones.name: Stonevein Domain
zones.description: A cathedral of living crystal at the range's core, its walls groaning as though the mountain itself were breathing.

entries.name: Goldenfield Steppe
entries.description: Open grassland and abandoned farmland under a hard, bright sun — sunflower terraces, trade roads and the walled herb gardens of an alchemy house nobody remembers. Horned herds and steppe foxes roam it in the open, sacred beasts graze where the light is strongest, and a golden dragon claims the whole sky over it.

zones.name: Sunblossom Fields
zones.description: Endless rows of sun-fed blossoms tended by no one anymore.

zones.name: Merchant's Highway
zones.description: A busy trade road littered with dropped wares and ambushers.

zones.name: Verdant Terraces
zones.description: Stepped paddies where spirit reeds and clover grow thick.

zones.name: Grazing Flats
zones.description: Open grassland roamed by herds of horned spirit-beasts.

zones.name: Apothecary Gardens
zones.description: The walled herb gardens of a vanished alchemy house.

zones.name: Caravan Crossroads
zones.description: A bustling junction where lost treasures change hands and hands.

zones.name: Goldcap Meadow
zones.description: A sun-drenched expanse where dawn lilies open at first light.

zones.name: Windmill Plateau
zones.description: A high, gale-swept plateau dotted with derelict spirit-mills.

zones.name: Sunkeepers Domain
zones.description: A gilded tableland at the heart of the steppe, its grasses burnished like metal beneath a sun that never sets.

zones.name: Sunkissed Meadow
zones.description: A gentle rolling meadow where white stags graze among goldenleaf and spring mint.

entries.name: Mistral Coast
entries.description: Tidal flats, reefs and fog-bound lagoons along a coast the storms never quite leave. Pearl coves and sunken wharves hold what the sea took; spirit horses run the strand, serpents hunt the shallows, and something vast moves beyond the sandbar when the tide goes out.

zones.name: Tideblossom Shoals
zones.description: Tidal flats where water-blossoms surface at the ebb.

zones.name: Coral Shelf
zones.description: A sunlit reef shelf where spirit-iron crusts the coral.

zones.name: Saltmarsh Reeds
zones.description: Brackish reed-beds heavy with jade reed and azure sage.

zones.name: Stormwrack Beach
zones.description: A wreck-strewn strand prowled by storm-touched tidal beasts.

zones.name: Pearl Diver's Cove
zones.description: A sheltered cove where divers once surfaced rare spirit-pearls.

zones.name: Mistveil Lagoon
zones.description: A fog-bound lagoon where dawn lilies float on still water.

zones.name: Leviathan Sandbar
zones.description: A vast tidal bar where elder manticores beach to feed.

zones.name: Drowned Wharf
zones.description: A sunken port whose flooded vaults still hold forgotten arms.

zones.name: Minstral Domain
zones.description: A drowned headland where the tide never fully withdraws and the sea heaves with something vast beneath.

zones.name: Minstral Port
zones.description: A half-abandoned port town where wind-born beasts circle the masts and frost ferns creep between the pier stones.

entries.name: Emberscar Highlands
entries.description: Volcanic uplands under endless ashfall, where magma veins cool into starsteel and sulphur quarries reek in the heat. Almost everything that lives here is fire-natured — ember bulls, burning manticores, chimeras nesting in the cinders — and a crimson drake rules from the crater at its heart.

zones.name: Cinderpetal Slopes
zones.description: Ash-warmed slopes where phoenixtail ferns thrive in the heat.

zones.name: Magma Vein Mine
zones.description: Half-molten tunnels where starsteel cools in the magma veins.

zones.name: Ashfall Barrens
zones.description: A grey waste under endless ashfall, stalked by ember manticores.

zones.name: Smoldering Caldera
zones.description: A live crater rim where fire essence and rare arms collect.

zones.name: Brimstone Quarry
zones.description: A reeking sulphur quarry rich in fire-tempered ore.

zones.name: Pyre Beast Lair
zones.description: A scorched den where ancient chimeras nest among the embers.

zones.name: Obsidian Flats
zones.description: A glassy black plain shot through with veins of starsteel.

zones.name: Ember Heart Crater
zones.description: The molten heart of the highlands, where the strongest beasts roar.

zones.name: Pyreheart Domain
zones.description: A furnace of a valley at the highlands' core, its rivers of magma lit red by the wings that pass overhead.

zones.name: Scarred Path
zones.description: A cracked trail over cooling lava where flame-antlered deer and spirit cats pick through the ash.

entries.name: Frostbound Tundra
entries.description: A white waste of glaciers, ice caves and frozen forest, where frostbells chime under the snow and ore is cut from blue ice. Serpents, basilisks and frost-furred cats hunt across it, revenants keep the spires, and a serpent dragon of the glacier coils at the centre of it all.

zones.name: Frostbell Hollow
zones.description: A snow-filled hollow where frostbells chime beneath the ice.

zones.name: Glacier Mine
zones.description: Ice-locked shafts where starsteel is cut from blue glacier walls.

zones.name: Rimewood Forest
zones.description: A frozen forest where frost-furred manticores stalk the drifts.

zones.name: Icewind Pass
zones.description: A howling pass where travelers froze with their treasures.

zones.name: Frozen Marrow Cavern
zones.description: A deep ice cave whose walls glitter with mystic ore.

zones.name: Snowveil Steppe
zones.description: A windswept white steppe where dawn lilies pierce the frost.

zones.name: Glacial Beast Warren
zones.description: A warren of ice-bound basilisks beneath the eternal glacier.

zones.name: Hoarfrost Spire
zones.description: A towering ice spire where frost revenants guard frozen relics.

zones.name: Chilled Waste
zones.description: A flat expanse of frozen meltwater where serpents slide beneath the ice and frost ferns crust the shallows.

zones.name: Frostseekers Domain
zones.description: A glacier-carved gorge at the tundra's heart, its ice walls scored by the coils of something immense.

entries.name: Stormridge Highlands
entries.description: High crags and plateaus under a storm that never breaks. Ore here hums with stored lightning and thunderpetals bloom where the strikes land; storm cats and chimeras ride the gale, djinn ride the lightning itself, and the beast that rules it answers to the storm alone.

zones.name: Thunderpetal Ridge
zones.description: A storm-lashed ridge where thunderpetals bloom in the strikes.

zones.name: Galeforce Plateau
zones.description: A high plateau scoured by chimeras riding the gale.

zones.name: Stormvein Lode
zones.description: A charged ore lode humming with stored lightning.

zones.name: Lightning-Scarred Steppe
zones.description: A blackened steppe where storm basilisks hunt in the squalls.

zones.name: Tempest Hollow
zones.description: A thunderhead-shrouded hollow where storm relics gather.

zones.name: Skybreak Cliffs
zones.description: Wind-torn cliffs where revenants mine the storm-charged rock.

zones.name: Roaring Tempest Basin
zones.description: A basin under a permanent storm where djinn ride the lightning.

zones.name: Stormcaller's Perch
zones.description: The highest crag, where the storm's own relics are hoarded.

zones.name: Pinnacle Summit
zones.description: A wind-scoured summit where frostbloom and cherry blossom cling to lightning-split rock and thunder-maned lions keep watch.

zones.name: Stormwatchers Domain
zones.description: The storm-crowned apex of the highlands, where lightning falls without pause onto blackened stone.

entries.name: Shadowmere Fen
entries.description: A drowned, moonlit fen of black bogs, flooded crypts and burial mounds full of dead cultivators' arms. Rare lotus and ancient roots grow in the quag; basilisks drag prey under, water elementals rule the deeps, and a dragon of yin shadow waits where the light gives out.

zones.name: Nightshade Marsh
zones.description: A black bog where nightshade lotus opens only in moonlight.

zones.name: Bogwretch Hollow
zones.description: A sucking quag denned by basilisks that drag prey under.

zones.name: Sunken Crypt Road
zones.description: A flooded causeway of crypts whose grave-goods still glint.

zones.name: Duskbloom Quag
zones.description: A twilight quagmire carpeted with rare ancient ginseng root and lotus.

zones.name: Witchlight Fen
zones.description: Pale corpse-lights drift over a fen rich with relics and dread.

zones.name: Drowned Barrow
zones.description: A flooded burial mound packed with the arms of dead cultivators.

zones.name: Gloomroot Mire
zones.description: A lightless mire where gloomroot drinks the souls of the lost.

zones.name: Wraithwater Deep
zones.description: The fen's drowned heart, ruled by primal water elementals.

zones.name: Shadowsoul Domain
zones.description: A sunken basin at the fen's black heart, where moon lilies glow above water no light can reach.

zones.name: Withered Bog
zones.description: A dying bog of grey reeds and ghostvine, where crystal lotus still blooms among the drowned trees.

entries.name: Chaotic Wastelands
entries.description: Land the world has stopped holding together — floating shards, torn seams bleeding raw essence and dead zones where Qi simply ceases. Primal elementals war without end, divine birds and aberrations drift between the rifts, and at the crater in its centre a cultivator who went too far still waits.

zones.name: Shattered Expanse
zones.description: A broken land of floating shards where djinn drift between rifts.

zones.name: Voidscar Rift
zones.description: A torn seam in the world that bleeds raw, unstable essence.

zones.name: Ruptured Ley Mine
zones.description: A collapsed ley-line shaft where starsteel grows wild and warped.

zones.name: Stormchaos Barrens
zones.description: A churning waste where primal elementals war without end.

zones.name: Howling Null
zones.description: A silent dead-zone where essence simply ceases — and relics remain.

zones.name: Cinderchaos Fields
zones.description: Burning chaos-fields prowled by primordial fire spirits.

zones.name: Abyssal Thornwaste
zones.description: A thorned hellscape where the last, rarest blooms cling to life.

zones.name: Worldscar Crater
zones.description: The wound at the heart of the wastes, where reality runs thin.

zones.name: Chaoslords Domain
zones.description: The last shattered plateau of the wastes, where the sky hangs in pieces and shadow vines root in nothing at all.

zones.name: Neverdream Crevasse
zones.description: A chasm whose depths whisper half-remembered dreams, where crystal lotus and briar grow in defiance of the void.

entries.name: Endless Rifts
entries.description: The deepest ground of the mortal world: flooded starwells, sunken sect vaults and trenches with no bottom, where light bends upward and every element rages at once. Heavenly qilin, dragons and things that predate the world hunt here, under the elder kraken that holds its drowned throne.

zones.name: Drowned Starwell
zones.description: A flooded star-shaft where light bends and relics drift upward.

zones.name: Riftmaw Trench
zones.description: A lightless trench whose mouth swallows primal elementals whole.

zones.name: Sunken Spirit Vault
zones.description: A submerged vault of an old sect, its treasury still sealed.

zones.name: Abyssal Rift
zones.description: A bottomless rift where primordial spirits coil in the dark.

zones.name: Primordial Hollow
zones.description: An air pocket from the world's dawn, where first-blooms still grow.

zones.name: Leviathan's Maw
zones.description: The mouth of a world-eating beast, hunted by heavenly qilin.

zones.name: Heavenfall Rift
zones.description: Where a piece of heaven fell and sank — its light still burning.

zones.name: Eternal Sunken Throne
zones.description: The drowned seat of a fallen god-beast — the realm's deadliest ground.

zones.name: Elemental Rapture
zones.description: A maelstrom where every element rages at once — the apex source of elemental essence.

zones.name: Yin-Yang Convergence
zones.description: The still point where yin and yang spiral into one — the sole font of their essences.

zones.name: Immortal Voids Domain
zones.description: The deepest drowned reach of the rifts, a black gulf where red coral blooms around the coils of an ancient presence.

zones.name: Riftbeast Den
zones.description: A cavern in the rift walls where phantom wolves hunt and frozen colossi stand like forgotten sentinels.

entries.name: Celestial Cloudsea
entries.description: The first land an ascended immortal stands on — peaks above an endless sea of cloud, jade isles drifting on the wind, and bridges and pavilions built by whoever came before. Celestial cranes and cloud dragons fill the sky, wind-spirits walk in human shape, and a sovereign of nine clouds holds the throne at the top.

zones.name: Cloudpiercing Peaks
zones.description: Needle-thin peaks rise above the cloud line, their slopes bright with violet and heather and loud with the gale.

zones.name: Azure Cloud Sea
zones.description: An endless blue ocean of cloud where typhoon serpents surface like whales and phoenixes skim the swells.

zones.name: Floating Jade Isles
zones.description: Islands of green jade drift on the cloudsea, ringed with sevenleaf herbs and roosting vermilion phoenixes.

zones.name: Heavenly Stairway
zones.description: A stair of cloud-white stone climbs past the wind's highest reach, coiled about by storm dragons.

zones.name: Whisperwind Valley
zones.description: In this sheltered cleft the wind falls to a murmur, and dreamfire phoenixes nest among thunder-veined rocks.

zones.name: Ninefold Cloud Bridge
zones.description: Arch upon arch of solid cloud spans a bottomless gulf, patrolled by blade-winged knights and monoliths of humming metal.

zones.name: Celestial Crane Grounds
zones.description: Shallow mist-meadows where cranes once gathered in great flocks, now haunted by frost-feathered phoenixes and moonlit guardians.

zones.name: Drifting Star Pavilion
zones.description: A pleasure-pavilion of the old immortals, drifting loose on the high winds with mistcrown lotus spilling from its eaves.

zones.name: Cloud Dragon's Nest
zones.description: Vast nests of woven cloud and skyiron cradle storm-dragon eggs, guarded by griffins born of the tempest.

zones.name: Skyfall Cliffs
zones.description: Sheer cliffs that end in open sky, where ninefold bellflowers cling above a drop with no bottom.

zones.name: Palace of Endless Dawn
zones.description: A cloud palace forever caught at first light, its empty halls coiled through by ghostly serpents.

zones.name: Cloudlord's Throne
zones.description: The cloudsea's summit, a ring of stormglass pillars where the winds of the whole realm converge and fall still.

entries.name: Sunfire Expanse
entries.description: A desert of golden fire beneath a sun that never sets: furnace valleys, rivers of molten light and the ruins of solar temples. Phoenixes roost in the canyons and firebirds wheel overhead; everything here is yang and flame, down to the primordial ancestor that burns at its heart.

zones.name: Goldenfire Desert
zones.description: Dunes of molten-gold sand where solar basilisks bask and phoenix reeds grow in the scarce shade.

zones.name: Sunscar Canyon
zones.description: A red-walled canyon split open by the sun's heat, its river boiling where solar sea dragons bathe.

zones.name: Flameheart Crater
zones.description: A crater lake of liquid fire where magma leviathans surface and sevenleaf herbs ring the scorched rim.

zones.name: Blazing Immortal Dunes
zones.description: Shifting dunes that smolder from within, ridden by golden dragons and swept by burning sandstorms.

zones.name: Vermilion Furnace Valley
zones.description: Sheer cliffs make a natural furnace of this valley, where flame lions prowl the coals and shadow vines thrive in the glare.

zones.name: Solaris Ruins
zones.description: The sun-bleached ruins of a temple to the sun, still tended by flame-robed emissaries and sun-tailed foxes.

zones.name: Heavenburnt Wastes
zones.description: A blackened plain where heaven's fire once fell, its glassy crust studded with sunstone.

zones.name: Phoenix Roost
zones.description: Towering spires of volcanic ember-rock where phoenixes return to burn and be reborn.

zones.name: Crimson Sunfields
zones.description: Fields of crimson grass that shimmer like flame at noon, hunted by sun foxes and flame-maned lions.

zones.name: Molten Heaven River
zones.description: A river of liquid fire pours from the sky and winds across the expanse, its banks thick with spirit gourd vines.

zones.name: The Eternal Pyre
zones.description: A pyre the size of a mountain that has burned since the realm's founding, its smoke hiding infernal leviathans.

zones.name: Primoridal Fire's Throne
zones.description: At the source of all fire in the expanse, the ground is a single sheet of white-hot stone beneath a sky of flame.

entries.name: Azure Immortal Sea
entries.description: A boundless celestial ocean of archipelagos, coral gardens and immortal palaces sunk beneath the waves. Sea dragons and their courts rule the water, celestial whales pass through the deeps, and the dragon king of the abyss keeps a throne at the bottom of the trench.

zones.name: Azure Immortal Sea
zones.description: Open blue water stretching past every horizon, where world-turtles drift like islands and ice sages walk the waves.

zones.name: Jadewave Archipelago
zones.description: Scattered green isles washed by jade-colored waves, their cliffs purple with lavender and violet.

zones.name: Dragon King's Trench
zones.description: A sea-floor chasm plunging into darkness, where sovereign whales sing and naga queens guard stormheart veins.

zones.name: Moonlit Tide Basin
zones.description: A tidal basin that floods silver under the moon, crossed at low water by glacial white tigers.

zones.name: Heavenly Coral Gardens
zones.description: Reefs of red and gold coral bloom in warm shallows where sea dragons and frost phoenixes hunt.

zones.name: Pearl Abyss
zones.description: A sinkhole of deep water lined with giant oysters, their pearls glimmering in the dark like distant stars.

zones.name: Stormtide Strait
zones.description: A narrow channel of crashing tides and constant squalls, where koi dragons leap the breakers.

zones.name: Sunken Immortal Palace
zones.description: The drowned palace of a sea immortal, its halls still lit by mistcrown lotus and patrolled by storm leviathans.

zones.name: Celestial Whale Grounds
zones.description: Calm open waters where celestial whales gather to breed, shadowed by ancient blue dragons.

zones.name: Nine-Tide Islands
zones.description: Islands pulled between conflicting tides, where ice sages and snow matriarchs keep their hermitages.

zones.name: Abyssal Blue Court
zones.description: A court of coral thrones on the deep sea floor, ruled in darkness by moon-abyss archons.

zones.name: Abysslord's Throne
zones.description: The lowest point of the immortal sea, where the water presses like a mountain and every current bends toward one dark throne.

entries.name: Eternal Frostlands
entries.description: A winter that has never ended: snowfields, frozen immortal cities and a graveyard of dragons locked in the ice. Water spirits and ice elementals drift through the silence, the dead of old wars still stand guard, and a sovereign who refused to die rules from beneath the frozen palace.

zones.name: Eternal Snowfields
zones.description: White snowfields without end, where leviathans swim beneath the frozen crust like shadows under glass.

zones.name: Frostveil Mountains
zones.description: Peaks wrapped in a veil of drifting ice-fog, where the spirits of frozen climbers wander the passes.

zones.name: Frozen Immortal City
zones.description: An immortal city locked whole in ice, its streets and towers preserved exactly as the cold found them.

zones.name: White Moon Glacier
zones.description: A glacier that glows white beneath the moon, its crevasses breathing a plague-chill from below.

zones.name: Nine Yin Ice Valley
zones.description: A valley where yin cold pools layer upon layer, its granite walls rimed thick and its springs frozen to the bottom.

zones.name: Crystalwind Plains
zones.description: Wind-polished plains where ice crystals hang in the air and starfall amaranth blooms through the frost.

zones.name: Heavenfrost Caverns
zones.description: Blue ice caverns hung with frozen waterfalls, where a winter immortal keeps a court of frost.

zones.name: Frozen Dragon Graveyard
zones.description: A field of colossal dragon bones half-buried in ice, where soul-laden leviathans circle the dead.

zones.name: Silverpine Wilderness
zones.description: A silent forest of silver-needled pines, where winter sovereigns walk and deathless yarrow grows beneath the snow.

zones.name: Heartfreeze Lake
zones.description: A lake frozen so deep its ice is clear as air, with white snow lotus blooming on the surface.

zones.name: Palace Beneath the Ice
zones.description: Beneath a crust of ancient ice lies a sealed palace whose throne rooms are guarded by glacier sovereigns.

zones.name: Deadly Silence Throne
zones.description: A hall of utter stillness at the frostlands' heart, where even the wind is frozen and the dead keep their places.

entries.name: Thunder Sovereignty
entries.description: A kingdom of storms, where tribulation lightning falls as weather and whole mountain ranges are scarred by it. Its people are the lightning made flesh — thunder cultivators and storm sovereigns in human form — and the origin of every bolt sits on its throne at the centre.

zones.name: Heavenstrike Mountains
zones.description: Mountains struck so often by heaven's lightning that their peaks have fused into stormglass, where thunder buddhas meditate.

zones.name: Thundercloud Basin
zones.description: A basin beneath a permanent thunderhead, its floor scorched and ringing with each strike.

zones.name: Ninefold Lightning Plains
zones.description: Plains where bolts fall in ordered volleys, leaving the granite earth seared with spiraling scars.

zones.name: Storm Emperor's Crater
zones.description: A vast crater blasted by a single ancient bolt, its rim crowned with voidsteel and its depths crackling still.

zones.name: Azure Thunder Valley
zones.description: A valley where blue lightning runs along the river like a living thing, and storm leviathans rise with the current.

zones.name: Tribulation Fields
zones.description: Scorched fields where cultivators once faced their tribulations, still watched over by thunder archons.

zones.name: Lightning Serpent Marsh
zones.description: A charged swamp where lightning arcs between the reeds and storm leviathans coil in the shallows.

zones.name: Skybreaker Ridge
zones.description: A jagged ridge that seems to split the sky, where storm sages gather the bolts that strike it.

zones.name: Thunderheart Lake
zones.description: A lake in which the storm's heartbeat can be felt, its waters flashing with lightning from below.

zones.name: Celestial Stormwall
zones.description: A wall of endless storm stretching from earth to heaven, its foot littered with godvein crystal.

zones.name: The Thousand Bolt Peaks
zones.description: A forest of stone spires, each drawing its own bolt, so that the peaks are never dark.

zones.name: Origin Bolt's Throne
zones.description: The source of all thunder in the realm, a peak where lightning rises from the ground instead of falling.

entries.name: Serene Wilds
entries.description: Primordial forest older than the mortal world, grown around the roots of the tree that holds the heavens up. Herb valleys and life springs feed it; stone guardians, ancient constructs and sacred deer keep it, and the ancestor of the world's roots sleeps at its throne.

zones.name: Primordial Jade Forest
zones.description: A forest of jade-barked trees older than memory, where spirit tortoises and guardian bulls wander in silence.

zones.name: Worldroot Grove
zones.description: A grove grown around one surfacing root of the worldtree, broad enough to hold a village on its bark.

zones.name: Ancient Spiritwood
zones.description: Moss-hung spiritwood trees stand so close the light turns green, sheltering golden-shelled tortoises.

zones.name: Celestial Herb Valley
zones.description: A valley carpeted with spirit peony and astral nightbloom, tended by stone constructs that never sleep.

zones.name: Emerald Beastlands
zones.description: Rolling emerald grasslands where worldtree stags lead herds through grass taller than a rider.

zones.name: Thousand-Year Bamboo Sea
zones.description: A bamboo forest that sways like the sea, each stalk ancient and thick as a temple pillar.

zones.name: Life Spring Basin
zones.description: A basin of warm springs where the earth's vitality wells up and leviathans wallow in the mud.

zones.name: Immortal Vine Ravine
zones.description: A ravine strangled by vines that never wither, beneath which magma leviathans stir in the deep earth.

zones.name: Sacred Deer Sanctuary
zones.description: A hushed glade where sacred deer graze and naga queens guard the pools of white snow lotus.

zones.name: Tree of Ten Thousand Leaves
zones.description: A single tree of impossible size whose canopy is a country, its boughs home to granite colossi.

zones.name: Worldroot Abyss
zones.description: The chasm where the worldtree's roots plunge into the earth's foundation, lit by veins of heaven's gold.

zones.name: Yggdrasil's Throne
zones.description: The worldtree's living crown, where every root and branch of the wilds is felt as one heartbeat.

entries.name: Astral Wastes
entries.description: The edge of the heavens, where constellations fell and the void shows through: meteor fields, glass deserts and the ruins of star observatories. Star-beasts and void-walkers hunt among the wreckage, and something that eats constellations waits where the last light ends.

zones.name: Starfall Plains
zones.description: Plains pocked with craters where stars fell, their glassy rims rich in verdant crystal and skyiron.

zones.name: Astral Ruins
zones.description: Toppled observatories of a forgotten sect lie half-buried in starlight, coiled through by shadow dragons.

zones.name: Voidglass Desert
zones.description: A desert of black glass that reflects a starfield absent from the sky, crossed by void whales in the dark air.

zones.name: Meteor King's Grave
zones.description: A great meteor lies buried where it struck, its crater the tomb of a king of stars.

zones.name: Celestial Observatory
zones.description: A ruined stargazing tower whose instruments still turn, watched by an unblinking eye of yin.

zones.name: Blackstar Canyon
zones.description: A canyon lit only by black stars, where many-eyed peacocks and eclipse phoenixes roost.

zones.name: Fallen Constellation Fields
zones.description: Fields scattered with the shattered remains of a constellation, still faintly glowing in their old pattern.

zones.name: Astral Beast Hunting Grounds
zones.description: Wide starlit hunting grounds where eclipse phoenixes stoop on prey from the void above.

zones.name: Heavenly Meteor Sea
zones.description: A sea of drifting meteors suspended in darkness, where void lotus monarchs meditate on the floating stones.

zones.name: Edge of the Void
zones.description: The last ground before nothing, where the stars thin out and lunar leviathans swim into the black.

zones.name: Starless Expanse
zones.description: A plain so far from any star that even the sovereigns of yin walk it in silence.

zones.name: Embodiment's Throne
zones.description: The hollow at the center of the wastes, where whole constellations go dark one star at a time.

entries.name: Radiant Dawnscape
entries.description: Endless golden plains under a permanent dawn — heavenly horse steppes, river basins and the hunting grounds of ancient clans. Divine beasts and sun-warriors in human form roam it in the open light, and the eternal sun emperor rules every inch the light touches.

zones.name: Golden Immortal Plains
zones.description: Golden plains bathed in eternal morning light, where dawn camellias bloom and celestial dragons glide low.

zones.name: Heavenly Horse Steppe
zones.description: A boundless steppe where heavenly horses run in herds, their hooves raising dust of pure gold.

zones.name: Goldenmane Grasslands
zones.description: Tall golden grasses ripple like a mane in the warm wind, shadowed by phoenixes of eternal day.

zones.name: Celestial Beast Road
zones.description: An ancient road paved with sun-warmed stone, walked by celestial beasts and golden titans on endless patrol.

zones.name: Sunset Sovereign Fields
zones.description: Fields held forever in the gold of sunset, where solar maidens tend shrines of deathless marble.

zones.name: Jadehorn Valley
zones.description: A valley of jade-horned beasts and royal lavender, warmed by a sun that hangs low and never sets.

zones.name: Golden River Basin
zones.description: A broad basin where the river runs gold with sunlight, its banks lined with void orchids and sovereign peonies.

zones.name: Ancient Clan Grounds
zones.description: The sun-faded halls and courtyards of an ancient immortal clan, now guarded by archangels of radiance.

zones.name: White Tiger Territory
zones.description: A savannah of pale grass claimed by white tigers, whose roars carry across the dawn.

zones.name: Heaven's Horizon
zones.description: The rim of the dawnscape, a blazing line of horizon where enlightened buddhas sit facing the endless sunrise.

zones.name: Emperor's Hunting Grounds
zones.description: Royal hunting parks of golden forest, still stalked by immortal ancestors who hunt for sport.

zones.name: Sun Emperor's Throne
zones.description: A dais of royal gold at the zenith of the realm, where the sun hangs directly overhead and nothing casts a shadow.

entries.name: Voidmoon Dominion
entries.description: Land under a black moon that never sets: twilight forests, ghost-lantern fields and rivers that carry the dead. Phantoms, drowned things and shadow cultivators move through the dark, and the sovereign of the black moon rules from the deepest night.

zones.name: Shadowmoon Forest
zones.description: A forest of black trees beneath the dark moon, where orbs of yin drift between the trunks like lanterns.

zones.name: Eternal Twilight Valley
zones.description: A valley caught forever between dusk and night, where white snow lotus glows in the half-light.

zones.name: Black Lotus Marsh
zones.description: A still marsh of black lotus and silent water, where the dead walk without leaving ripples.

zones.name: Moonless Mountains
zones.description: Jagged peaks that blot out every moon, their passes haunted by shadow dragons and hell drakes.

zones.name: Ghost Lantern Fields
zones.description: Fields lit by countless floating ghost lanterns, each one a soul that never found its way home.

zones.name: Nine Yin Ravine
zones.description: A narrow ravine where the cold of the grave settles thick, its floor choked with plague-laden mist.

zones.name: Silent Grave Plains
zones.description: Endless grave mounds stretch beneath the black moon, where void lotus monarchs meditate among the dead.

zones.name: Phantom River
zones.description: A river of mist that flows in no direction, carrying the shadows of wraiths along its course.

zones.name: Darkmoon Lake
zones.description: A black lake reflecting a moon that is not in the sky, watched by an eye of the endless void.

zones.name: Hall of Forgotten Souls
zones.description: A vast hall of empty thrones and nameless tablets, where the forgotten dead gather in silence.

zones.name: The Endless Night
zones.description: Night that has never broken, where void whales swim overhead and eclipse phoenixes are the only light.

zones.name: Nightwalker's Throne
zones.description: The lightless seat of the dominion, bathed in the cold glow of the black moon directly above.

entries.name: Heavenly Light Sanctuary
entries.description: The last sanctuary of the heavens, where the first immortals walked and scripture is written into the valleys themselves. Divine guardians and immortal remnants keep its roads and lotus fields, and at its summit waits the one who has already seen everything.

zones.name: Sacred Heaven Valley
zones.description: A valley full of soft golden light and immortal lotus, where ancestral spirits drift among the blossoms.

zones.name: Jade Emperor Mountains
zones.description: Snow-white mountains crowned with jade temples, their stairways climbed by void lotus monarchs.

zones.name: Celestial Dao Plains
zones.description: Plains where the Dao is written into the grass itself, each blade tracing a fragment of scripture.

zones.name: Ten Thousand Immortals Road
zones.description: A road of white stone lined with statues of every immortal who ascended before.

zones.name: Heavenly Scripture Valley
zones.description: Golden scripture is carved into every cliff of this valley, guarded by enlightened ones and a singularity of thought.

zones.name: Golden Lotus Fields
zones.description: Shining fields of golden lotus, where soul meditation masters sit in perfect stillness.

zones.name: Divine Ancestor Grounds
zones.description: Sacred grounds where the divine ancestors are honored, watched over by archangels of souls.

zones.name: Immortal Ascension Stairway
zones.description: A stairway of pure light rising beyond sight, its steps worn smooth by those who climbed before.

zones.name: Celestial Dao River
zones.description: A river of liquid starlight that carries the Dao downstream, its banks bright with dragon aloe.

zones.name: Heaven's Sacred Lake
zones.description: A lake of utterly clear water that reflects the soul rather than the face, tended by Dao sages.

zones.name: The First Immortal Ruins
zones.description: The ruins of the first immortal's dwelling, where empresses of soul and mist keep endless vigil.

zones.name: The Grand Omniscient's Throne
zones.description: The sanctuary's innermost light, a chamber of white flame where every thought is laid bare.
